rationale: REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_RATIONALE -- this record supersedes decisions/owner-approvals/control-gate-pin-bump-launch-a-draft.json (v1), which is kept in place only as a frozen record of the discovered structural impossibility, not as a candidate for signature. v1 requires the signed record to state the exact commit SHA (candidateTree) of the commit that will contain it; that commit's tree necessarily changes when the record is added to product/dependency-verification.json, so it changes its own resulting SHA -- a commit cannot state its own hash inside itself. This v2 schema (scripts/verify-control-dependencies.mjs: CONTROL_PIN_BUMP_SCHEMA_V2, baseCheckerPinBumpErrorsV2) drops baseTree/candidateTree entirely and binds only deterministic content that is fully known before the record is authored: the exact bytes of product/dependency-pins.json (basePinsSha256/candidatePinsSha256), the exact base checker blob this approval was reviewed against (baseChecker), and the exact enumerated control-surface digest changes (controls) via the existing sameControlChanges comparison -- unchanged from v1. Positive/negative tests proving this in scripts/tests/control-dependencies.test.mjs: 'the base control checker permits a v2 owner-approved pin bump with no commit-SHA binding', 'a v2 pin bump approval does not depend on the commit-SHA that ships it' (same approval object checked against two different candidateTree values, both pass), 'rejects a v2 pin bump whose approval token is not a formal owner token', 'rejects a v2 pin bump record carrying a v1-only field' (exact-keys check via sameKeys/CONTROL_PIN_BUMP_V2_KEYS), and 'rejects a v2 pin bump approved for one control-surface change but shipped with another' (an unrelated pinned control file mutated after the approval was computed is refused, proving an unchanged approval cannot admit altered controls it never enumerated). The controls entry below is the actual, real digest change for scripts/verify-control-dependencies.mjs itself between baseTree 37c0f955f76410e9c9863e77cdc33fd48ffd1306 and the current candidate content on codex/launch-a (git hash-object scripts/verify-control-dependencies.mjs), covering both A1's earlier admission of web-ci.yml/deploy-web.yml into PERMITTED_WORKFLOW_PATHS and this v2 schema addition itself -- see the bootstrap note below for why the checker's own pin is necessarily part of this same record.

bootstrapIntervention.problem: The v2 code path itself lives in scripts/verify-control-dependencies.mjs, which is one of the six pinned control-surface files. Shipping v2 support therefore changes the checker's own digest away from the value currently pinned in product/dependency-pins.json (controlScripts.controlDependencyVerifier), which is exactly the class of change the control gate exists to block without an approved pin bump. Since v1 is structurally unusable (see rationale) and v2 does not exist in CI until this very commit lands, there is a one-time chicken-and-egg gap: no pin-bump record of either schema can honestly admit the commit that FIRST introduces v2 support, because v1 cannot describe its own commit and v2-the-mechanism is not yet trusted by any CI run that predates this commit.
bootstrapIntervention.requiredOneTimeAction: The owner (not A) must review this exact candidate diff (scripts/verify-control-dependencies.mjs, scripts/tests/control-dependencies.test.mjs, and this file) by direct inspection -- reading the diff and running the test suite locally or in a trusted context outside the automated control gate -- and, if satisfied, take ONE explicit bootstrap action to admit the specific commit that ships v2 support. This is necessarily an out-of-band, human, one-time act; it cannot be delegated to the gate the commit is changing.
